steps: Sign in to your eCitizen account.

Complete the application and payment process.

passport_application.name: Kenyan Passport Application
passport_application.description: Application for a Kenyan passport through the Directorate of Immigration Services.
requirements: Duly filled application Form 19 and two payment invoices.
Original birth certificate and a copy for Kenyan citizens by birth.
Certificate of Registration for citizens by registration.
Original applicant's national identity card and a copy for adults.
Duly filled Consent Form for minors.
Copies of parents' national identity cards or death certificates where applicable.
Original and copies of parents' birth certificates.
steps: Apply online through the eCitizen portal.
Book an appointment through the eCitizen portal.
Attend the selected passport processing centre to submit the application and complete biometric enrolment.
